nodes.title: LTX RIPPLE — CLEAN MODE
widgets_values:
## NORMAL USE
1. **INPUT VIDEO**
2. **EDITED FIRST FRAME**
3. **OUTPUT WIDTH / HEIGHT**
4. Prompt (optional)

## CUT GUIDE
Set **IS THERE A CUT SCENE?** to **NO** for first-frame-only mode.
Set it to **YES** only when you want to use the second cut reference.

When YES: use **CUT TIMELINE** → mark/export the cut frame → edit the PNG → load it into **EDITED CUT FRAME**.
When NO: the cut branch is skipped lazily, so the workflow runs only from the first-frame guide.

nodes.title: 0 - INSTALLATION / MODELS / FIRST USE
widgets_values:
# FIRST-TIME SETUP — READ ONCE

## 1) INSTALL CUSTOM NODES
Install from **ComfyUI Manager → Install Custom Nodes** (or clone the repos into `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/`).

- **ComfyUI-LTXVideo** — https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo
- **ComfyUI-KJNodes** — https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes
- **ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite** — https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite
- **RES4LYF** — https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF
- **RippleTimelineMarker** — https://github.com/16Gig/ComfyUI-RippleTimelineMarker/

For **RippleTimelineMarker**, clone or download the repo and place the folder inside:
`ComfyUI/custom_nodes/`

After installing, **restart ComfyUI**. If the browser was already open, do **Ctrl+F5** once.

## 2) DOWNLOAD THESE MODELS
Official LTX-2.5 files: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5
Ripple LoRA: https://huggingface.co/WepeNerd/LTX-Ripple

### Transformer
`ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors`
→ `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`

### Text Encoder
`gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors`
→ `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/`

### Video VAE
`ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors`
→ `ComfyUI/models/vae/`

### Audio VAE
`ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors`
→ `ComfyUI/models/vae/`

### Ripple LoRA
`LTX25_Ripple_v11.safetensors`
→ `ComfyUI/models/loras/`

> If a downloaded filename differs slightly, select the correct file once in the relevant loader node and save the workflow.

## 3) NORMAL USE
Only touch the green **USER CONTROLS** area:
**Input Video → Edited First Frame → Output Size → Seed → Prompt.**

If a cut needs another visual anchor, use **CUT TIMELINE**, mark/export that frame, edit the PNG, then load it into **EDITED CUT FRAME**. The marked frame index is passed automatically — do not type frame numbers manually.
